source_review.execution: One producer clock across retries, earlier company admission, interpretation/publication reserves, completed subset publication and dated prior results. Shared cancellation reaches search threads, browser queues and owned browser processes. No new narrative generated by code.
source_review.home: Retain source acquisition and full Pro editorial synthesis/review. The redundant enrichment acquisition pass becomes composition over complete acquired evidence and dated analysis. Preserve accepted no-tool 65/35 writing/review allocation.
source_review.learning: Persist frozen eval input in the durable learning event; fresh connections can read it after replica loss. Older missing local paths migrate from their original saved event and critique. Actual unfinished reviews remain visible.
source_review.recovery: Healthy paginated progress is not failure; actual repair errors remain Warning.
source_review.timeline: Common evidence timing instructions plus complete source body and original investigation date at the news handoff. No ticker-specific rule or age cutoff.
source_review.preserved: Two production news slots, source breadth, complete contexts, full analytical-model default, existing provider accounting and balance protection, managed identity, database/publication contracts, consumer commands and remaining resource images.

personal_findings: NBIS enrichment distinguishes the October25 statement, October26 financing report and October27 reaction; includes financing terms to investigate without claiming the warning is a new disclosure.
Full Home editor completed with all50 raw source reports. Personally inspected every public story field: dated Musk context, other market/company stories retained, opinions attributed.
Source nomination reads all50 reports and identifies useful company/financing/policy leads without renewing the old statement date.

Actual news interpretation uses full acquired article text. It explicitly says the underlying warning is October25 and identifies the report as a recap with financing observations. Limited supplied company memory remains an explicit limitation.

operational_checks.command: pytest selected production boundaries, recurring inference, browsing, learning, news, gateway, execution, settings and native LLM boundary suites
operational_checks.known_baseline_failures: Two broader harness-contract fixture failures reproduced on accepted HEAD: old shortened-history expectation and outdated review fixture. Not introduced by this release.

limits: A native capacity probe does not establish the completion rate or cost of an entire two-hour scheduled run.
Eight workers reduce waiting; concurrency is not itself a monetary saving.
90% total account reduction remains a goal, not a measured result.
Learning replay now has durable input; its overall one-hour cadence may require a separate admission budget if cold critique volume grows.
